title: A Rivergate for the Passage
premise: Ivo Marchetti, a desert ranger chasing a thief who stole her late mentor's compass, follows the debt into a drowned coastal kingdom where the tide has exposed a legendary wreck. The thief, Sefa, is not a villain but the wreck's disinherited heir, and together with a salvage-fleet defector they race to claim the ship's manifest — proof of a stolen inheritance that could indict the fleet's admiral. Beating the fleet by six tides before monsoon landfall, Ivo must choose between her bounty and justice outside the law; she burns the contract, testifies to the manifest, and gains a found family instead of a payment.
about_author: Mara Okafor is a former marine cartographer who spent five years charting tidal caves along forgotten trade coasts before turning to fiction. She writes adventure stories about debts, tides, and the families people build when the law fails them.

chapters.title: The Debt in the Sand
chapters.summary: Ivo Marchetti tracks thief Sefa Vane across the salt flats, armed with her dead mentor's stolen compass and a six-year-old debt. POV: Ivo. Beat: grim determination curdling into doubt when she realizes the compass points not north but seaward.

chapters.title: What the Tide Uncovered
chapters.summary: Reaching the coast, Ivo corners Sefa at low tide as the sea withdraws to reveal a cave mouth and the ribs of a legendary wreck. POV: Ivo. Beat: awe displacing anger as legends prove real and her quarry stops running.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: Sefa reveals the wreck holds her family's seized manifest, proof against Admiral Corvane of the salvage fleet; the monsoon arrives in six tides. POV: alternating Ivo/Sefa. Beat: reluctant alliance forged over shared betrayal.

chapters.title: The Defector
chapters.summary: They recruit Brannoc, a salvage diver sick of Corvane's erasures, who knows the cave's flooded passages. POV: Brannoc. Beat: cautious trust tested when fleet scouts spot their campfire.

chapters.title: Drowned Rooms
chapters.summary: First dive through the cave's drowned chambers; Ivo confronts water terror from a childhood drowning while Sefa navigates by memory of her grandmother's songs. POV: Ivo. Beat: fear transmuted into belonging.

chapters.title: The Manifest Lies Below
chapters.summary: They find the strongroom but the manifest case is sealed by a tide-locked mechanism needing three keys held by different heirs — one dead, one missing. POV: Sefa. Beat: hope dashed, then hardened into resolve.

chapters.title: Corvane's Offer
chapters.summary: Admiral Corvane captures Brannoc and offers Ivo double her bounty plus her debt erased if she surrenders Sefa. POV: Ivo. Beat: temptation at its sharpest — the debt was her mentor's dying wish.

chapters.title: Fifth Tide
chapters.summary: Ivo fakes surrender to infiltrate the fleet, frees Brannoc, and steals the admiral's own heir-key; storm winds rise early. POV: Ivo. Beat: betrayal of the law embraced as loyalty to something better.

chapters.title: Landfall
chapters.summary: Climax: in the flooding cave as the monsoon hits, the trio opens the strongroom as Corvane's divers close in; Sefa nearly drowns holding the manifest, saved by Ivo and Brannoc. POV: all three. Beat: sacrifice and solidarity against greed.

chapters.title: A Rivergate for the Passage
chapters.summary: Resolution: the manifest convicts Corvane; Sefa restores her inheritance and names Ivo and Brannoc kin in the old legal rite. Ivo's debt forgiven by the mentor's hidden letter inside the compass. POV: Ivo. Beat: peace — justice kept, family found, rivergate open.
